info.description: The agency's agents, their sessions, turns and runs, the executions on the agent host, the co-worker pool and places, providers, models, tiers and roads, accounts and rest, companions and workers, worker assignments, and the jobs it runs. A job is an item run on a worker for the harness that holds the item: the harness asks for a worker with POST /assignments, then hands the item's content and its lease over with POST /jobs. The agency never calls the job service and keeps no client of it: the run's progress, questions and outcome are its own events and fields, which the harness reads and carries into the job service, where it reports and closes the item; words appended to the item reach the run as the harness sends them into the job's session. Everything it remembers or runs on is an upstream it calls through that upstream's client. It serves only its own nouns: a run with a fixed prompt is an ordinary session started with POST /sessions and the run's prompt document, and that session calls the upstreams it needs through their own MCP servers; no route or tool of the agency forwards to them. It calls no downstream; gate and receiver register at its hook points. It stays one service.
